title: Casts from and to strings
verdict: strict parsing; shortest round-trip for doubles; no string → bool or date
description: Text to an integer accepts an optional sign and digits only (` 2`, `3.0`, `1e2`, `0x10` fail); text to a double accepts `nan`, `inf`, `-Infinity`, `.5`, `5.` and rounds `1e400` to inf. Failures raise with `strict=True` and are NULL with `strict=False`.

A double becomes its shortest round-trip text, with an exponent at 1e16 (`1e+16`) and at 1e-7 (`1e-7`), without one at 1e15 and 1e-5, `-0.0`, `inf` and `NaN`. Booleans become `true` and `false`; integers and doubles become booleans by `!= 0` (NaN is true).
Text to `Boolean` or to `Date` is refused (`InvalidOperationError`); `str.to_date` parses dates.
The docs are silent on the text forms that parse, how a double prints and text to `Boolean` being refused: a docs gap.
No upstream test pins the rejected forms, `nan`/`inf` parsing or the double's text format; they may change between versions.
reference: Casts to and from strings follow the reference's `cast` rules; `cast_failure` as stated.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_polars` runs each expression on edge cases (0, ±1, ±2, 3, ±7, the bounds of the integer width; 0.5, ±2.5, 7, 1e308, ±inf, NaN; NULL), one row at a time, and compares each row with Lean's outcome of the Substrait call under each candidate option (`substrait-check --outcomes`). Observations are Polars programs whose result is recorded as it is. Polars 2.1.0 (Python), Rust crates at tag py-2.1.0 (commit 7f902bd3), on macOS arm64.

notes: Streaming gives what in memory gives on every probe and observation cited here.
The observations' frames hold a few rows, which streaming runs as one-row morsels; the probes' 6000-row columns cover morsels of many rows.

`python -m sverify_dev.probe_polars --diff --write` runs each probe one row at a time and on a 6000-row column with `collect(engine='in-memory')` and `collect(engine='streaming')`, and each observation twice: its `df(...)` frame's `select`, `with_columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `unique`, `join` and `group_by` go through the streaming engine the second time (`StreamingFrame`); the `s-` observations collect a lazy query on each engine themselves. Polars 2.1.0 (Python), macOS arm64.

evidence.note: integers: atoi_simd::parse::<_, true, true> (0.18.1), sign and digits; doubles: fast_float2::parse (0.2.4)
unparsable text becomes NULL; strict mode raises on the new NULLs
double to text: zmij 1.0.23 shortest round-trip
Boolean to text: true/false (the doc comments at L38 and mod.rs L379 say 1/0)
text to Date bails (removed in 2.0); number to Boolean is != 0; no text arm for Boolean, so it bails

states strict/non-strict only; silent on accepted text formats, float text format and text to Boolean
test_leading_plus_zero_int/uint/float: sign and leading zeros accepted, '-.5', '0.', '+.5' parse; eager Series.cast (in-memory)
test_string_to_temporal_cast_unsupported: text to Date/Datetime/Time raises InvalidOperationError (in-memory)
